title: Privacy Team Manager
description:
* Urval sker löpande
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Vill du vara med och utmana den svenska telekommarknaden i ett bolag som drivs av utmanartänk, entreprenörsanda och gemensamt arbete i ett härligt gäng? Då kan rollen som Privacy Team Manager på Tre vara helt rätt för dig!  

  



**Om rollen**
  

Vi söker en Privacy Team Manager som vill vara med och forma hur dataskydd blir en naturlig del av affären. Du leder Tres Privacy-team, som består av två specialister, och har en central roll i att utveckla och driva dataskyddsarbetet framåt. Här får du både utmana befintliga arbetssätt och hitta smarta, pragmatiska lösningar som säkerställer ett enhetligt och riskbaserat arbete alltid med verksamhetens behov i fokus. Du rapporterar till Head of Legal.
  

  

En stor del av rollen handlar om att vara ett nära och uppskattat stöd till verksamheten i kvalificerade frågor kopplade till GDPR och andra dataskyddsregelverk. Du driver också utvecklingen av våra processer och arbetssätt och ser till att Privacy kommer in tidigt när vi fattar affärsbeslut, utvecklar produkter eller driver förändringsinitiativ. För att lyckas samarbetar du nära både kollegorna inom Legal och team inom bland annat Sourcing, Informationssäkerhet, HR och produktorganisationen, liksom med DPO.


Du ansvarar även för myndighetskontakter och incidenthantering samt håller Head of Legal och ledningen uppdaterade om risker och viktiga utvecklingsområden. Med Tres fortsatta satsningar på digitalisering, AI och nya produkter får du dessutom vara med och möjliggöra innovation och utveckling. Här handlar det inte bara om att säkerställa att vi gör rätt, utan också om att hitta smarta lösningar som gör att vi kan fortsätta utmana och utvecklas.

**I din roll som ledare**
  

Som ledare på Tre är du tydlig, coachande och närvarande. Du skapar förutsättningar för teamet att växa, ta ansvar och göra ett riktigt bra jobb. Du gillar att skapa struktur och tydliga prioriteringar, samtidigt som du bygger en prestigelös teamkänsla där ni delar kunskap och hjälper varandra framåt.


I ett mindre specialistteam är du både ledare och en del av det operativa arbetet. Du är trygg i din kompetens, tar egna initiativ och gillar att driva frågor framåt tillsammans med teamet och resten av verksamheten.

  

  

**Du kan se fram emot att**

* Leda och utveckla Tres dataskyddsarbete i en verksamhetskritisk funktion, med både strategiskt ansvar och operativt fokus.
* Vara med och möjliggöra Tres utveckling inom digitalisering, produktutveckling och AI genom smarta, affärsnära lösningar.
* Utveckla och coacha ett engagerat specialistteam med hög kompetens inom dataskydd och integritet.
* vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work, samt arbeta i en organisation som är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar

**Så här beskriver rekryterande chef Catrin sitt ledarskap:**


"Mitt ledarskap bygger på tillit, tydlighet och öppen dialog. Jag tror på frihet under ansvar och att ge stort mandat, samtidigt som jag finns nära till hands för stöd och vägledning. Jag värdesätter ett prestigelöst samarbete där kompetens, nyfikenhet och ambition går hand i hand med viljan att dela kunskap och utvecklas tillsammans. För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara trygg i din kompetens, ta ansvar, fatta egna beslut och ha gott omdöme."  

  



**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Lite mer om dig**
  

Vi tror att du är en driven och prestigelös person som gillar när det händer saker. Du tar gärna initiativ, hittar lösningar och är förmodligen den i omgivningen som snabbt svarar ”Jajamän, det löser vi!”. Samtidigt trivs du med att samarbeta, utveckla andra och kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. Med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och förmågan att göra komplex juridik begriplig omsätter du kunskap till konkreta råd och lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.


Vi tror att du har flera års kvalificerad juridisk erfarenhet och har arbetat med dataskydd och integritet på senior nivå, gärna i en större eller komplex organisation. Du är van vid att självständigt driva frågor från analys och riskbedömning till rekommendation och genomförande, och har gedigen erfarenhet av incidenthantering, incidentrapportering och myndighetskontakter, exempelvis med IMY eller PTS.


Kanske har du redan erfarenhet av formellt personalansvar, eller så är du en senior jurist som har lett projekt, drivit frågor och väglett kollegor och nu är redo att ta steget in i din första chefsroll.


En djup kunskap om GDPR och svensk dataskyddslagstiftning är en självklarhet, liksom förståelse för styrning och riskhantering. Erfarenhet från telekom eller annan reglerad verksamhet är meriterande, liksom kunskap inom AI-governance, LEK, ePrivacy och NIS2.


Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska och har lätt för att göra komplexa frågor begripliga för olika målgrupper, från specialister till ledningsgrupper.

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**


Vi tar emot ansökningar via den här annonsen och går igenom dem löpande. Du behöver inte skicka med ett personligt brev, bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna i samband med din ansökan.


Så här ser vägen till Tre ut: Vi börjar med ett urval, följt av tester och en kortare telefonintervju. Därefter får du träffa rekryterande chef i en första intervju, följt av en kompetensbaserad intervju med vår Talent Acquisition Partner. För slutkandidaten ingår även en sista intervju med våra ägare CK Hutchison och därefter referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.


Vi använder tester som en del av urvalet för att skapa en så objektiv och rättvis bedömning som möjligt. Vi intervjuar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.  

  



**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar

**Om företaget**
----------------

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.


Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.


När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.

**WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS** - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.

**WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS** - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.

 **WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES** - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: IRIS² Software & Platform Architect
description:
**Description**
---------------


The IRIS² Software & Platform Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and maintaining the end-to-end software and platform architecture for the IRIS² EU Communication Gateway.
  

  

The role ensures that software products, platform services, and supporting infrastructure delivered by SSC Space, subcontractors, and external programme stakeholders form a coherent, secure, resilient, and verifiable solution across gateway sites, central functions, and operational environments.
  

  

Working closely with the Software Technical Lead, Lead System Architect, System Engineering, IVV, Cyber Security, Configuration Management, Infrastructure teams, and supplier architects, the Software & Platform Architect translates programme requirements and operational needs into an integrated architectural baseline that supports development, integration, deployment, operations, and future evolution.
  

  

As SSC Space is responsible for integrating multiple supplier-developed solutions into a single operational gateway environment, this role provides architectural leadership across software products, interfaces, deployment platforms, security domains, and lifecycle management activities.  

  

  

**Requirements**
----------------


**Required Qualifications & Experience**
* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience as a Software Architect, Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Platform Architect within complex distributed systems.
* Strong experience defining software decomposition, service boundaries, functional allocation, integration patterns, and platform architectures.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate multiple commercial, customized, and supplier-developed software products.
* Experience working within a prime contractor, systems integrator, or comparable multi-supplier environment.
* Strong understanding of APIs, messaging technologies, data flows, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience designing distributed, high-availability, and geographically distributed systems.
* Understanding of cloud, virtualized, and containerized platforms and their associated infrastructure requirements.
* Knowledge of identity management, access control, secure communications, and security-by-design principles.
* Experience designing software architectures that support integration, verification, operational support, and lifecycle maintenance.
* Ability to assess supplier architectures and identify cross-system dependencies, risks, and integration gaps.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable Experience**
* Space ground segment, satellite communications, telecommunications, defence, or mission-critical infrastructure programmes.
* Monitoring and control systems, network-management platforms, orchestration systems, or SCADA environments.
* Integration of software with RF systems, antenna systems, modem platforms, and operational technology environments.
* ESA, ECSS, or other regulated engineering frameworks.
* Ground Segment and end-to-end IVV/IVVQ programmes.
* Security-sensitive or accreditation-driven systems.
* High-availability databases, API gateways, identity platforms, and message brokers.
* Hybrid IaaS and PaaS deployment models.
* Software factories, DevSecOps, automated deployment pipelines, and release-management environments.
* Long-lifecycle programmes requiring product evolution, supplier coordination, and obsolescence management.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**End-to-End Software Architecture**
* Define and maintain the end-to-end software and platform architecture for the EU COMM GW solution.
* Translate operational concepts, programme requirements, and technical constraints into architectural principles and system structures.
* Define functional decomposition and allocation of software responsibilities across SSC Space, suppliers, and external systems.
* Ensure architectural consistency across internally coordinated, supplier-developed, and commercial software products.
* Establish and maintain clear architectural boundaries between gateway-management, antenna-management, monitoring, control, infrastructure, and external systems.
* Lead architectural trade studies and document key decisions, assumptions, and constraints.
* Maintain architectural coherence throughout development, integration, deployment, operations, and system evolution.

**Integration & Interface Architecture**
* Define and maintain the software interface architecture across gateway subsystems and external Ground Segment systems.
* Define service boundaries, interface ownership, APIs, messaging patterns, and data-flow architectures.
* Coordinate architectural design for integrations with external systems, identity services, and supporting operational platforms.
* Ensure communication semantics, metadata, timing requirements, error handling, and security requirements are consistently addressed.
* Identify interface gaps, overlapping responsibilities, incompatible assumptions, and cross-supplier integration risks.
* Lead architectural resolution of technical issues spanning multiple suppliers and subsystems.
* Support development and maintenance of Interface Control Documents together with System Engineering teams.
* Ensure supplier interfaces remain aligned with the approved architectural baseline.

**Platform & Deployment Architecture**
* Define application and platform architectures required to host gateway software workloads.
* Define middleware, networking, compute, storage, resiliency, and operational requirements for both gateway and central environments.
* Coordinate software platform requirements with infrastructure, hosting, and data-centre teams.
* Maintain architectural consistency across development, integration, verification, pre-operational, operational, maintenance, and training environments.
* Define principles for deployment, upgrade, rollback, disaster recovery, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure platform architecture supports scalability, resilience, maintainability, and geographical distribution requirements.
* Coordinate the use of infrastructure and platform services while ensuring compatibility with supplier products.
* Identify platform-related risks, dependencies, and operational constraints.

**Supplier Architecture Governance**
* Establish architectural principles, standards, and constraints applicable to software subcontractors.
* Review supplier software and platform architectures for consistency with programme objectives.
* Ensure supplier decisions do not introduce gaps, unnecessary dependencies, conflicting behaviours, or excessive coupling.
* Maintain visibility of architectural dependencies across supplier products and solutions.
* Coordinate architecture reviews, interface reviews, and assessments of significant system changes.
* Ensure suppliers provide sufficient architectural information to support integration, verification, accreditation, and lifecycle support.
* Support supplier-risk assessments and architecture-related change evaluations.
* Maintain clear ownership boundaries between supplier product architectures and SSC Space's end-to-end architecture responsibility.

**Security & Identity Architecture**
* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded throughout the software and platform architecture.
* Coordinate architectural decisions with Cyber Security and Security Engineering functions.
* Define architecture principles for authentication, authorization, identity federation, role management, and privileged-access control.
* Ensure appropriate segregation between environments, security domains, tenants, and operational functions.
* Define secure patterns for APIs, messaging, certificates, secrets management, and software artifact exchange.
* Ensure supplier access, remote support, and maintenance functions comply with approved security architectures.
* Support security-risk assessments, accreditation activities, and security-verification processes.
* Assess security impacts of significant platform and architecture changes.

**Resilience, Availability & Operability**
* Define software and platform architecture supporting high availability and operational continuity requirements.
* Coordinate redundancy, failover, replication, backup, and recovery principles across supplier products.
* Ensure local gateway functions can continue operating during central-service outages where required.
* Define monitoring, logging, observability, diagnostics, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ensure operational, degraded, maintenance, and recovery modes remain architecturally coherent across the solution.
* Support RAMS and business-continuity analysis activities.
* Ensure architectural decisions support long-term maintainability and operational stability.

**Integration, Verification & Release Architecture**
* Ensure architecture supports progressive integration and formal verification activities.
* Define architectural principles for testability, simulation, emulation, and observability.
* Coordinate architecture requirements for subsystem, Ground Segment, and end-to-end verification environments.
* Ensure supplier products can be integrated and verified using representative interfaces, simulators, stubs, and test environments.
* Establish architectural constraints supporting automated deployment, regression testing, and release promotion.
* Support resolution of integration and verification findings with architectural impact.
* Ensure architecture documentation supports reviews, acceptance, qualification, and accreditation activities.
* Support technically consistent release planning across multiple software suppliers.

**Lifecycle & Evolution Management**
* Maintain a software and platform architecture roadmap aligned with programme evolution and operational needs.
* Assess impacts of supplier upgrades, technology changes, security vulnerabilities, and component obsolescence.
* Ensure architecture supports controlled replacement and evolution of supplier solutions where practical.
* Reduce unnecessary vendor dependencies and excessive system coupling.
* Support evaluation of emerging technologies without disrupting the operational baseline.
* Maintain architectural knowledge, rationale, and design decisions throughout the programme lifecycle.
* Support transition of architecture ownership into operational and maintenance phases.
**Benefits**
------------


At SSC Space, you will have the opportunity to contribute to one of Europe's most ambitious space programmes while helping shape the future of satellite communications and space infrastructure.
  

  

**We offer:**  

* A highly influential role within a strategically important European space programme.
* Significant freedom and responsibility to plan and manage your work.
* Challenging and meaningful assignments in a cutting-edge space environment.
* Continuous professional development and learning opportunities.
* A collaborative workplace with highly skilled, dedicated, and passionate colleagues.
* The opportunity to contribute to the future of the European space industry.

**Additional Benefits**
* 30 days of annual vacation.
* Additional paid leave throughout the year, including time off between Christmas and New Year and on Ascension Day, corresponding to approximately 6-11 extra days annually depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bicycle through a tax-efficient leasing programme.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote health, wellbeing, culture, and teamwork.
* Collective Agreement including occupational pension, parental pay, and comprehensive insurance coverage.

**About SSC Space**  

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, supporting satellite communications, space missions, Earth observation, launch services, and mission operations worldwide. With decades of experience in the space industry and a strong international presence, SSC Space enables governments, agencies, commercial operators, and space organisations to realise their missions through reliable and innovative space solutions.

title: Data Protection Sales Lead
description:
Data Protection Sales Lead  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**The Data Protection Sales Lead** is the primary Subject Matter Expert for Storage and related products. Responsible for driving storage sales in an assigned territory, industry, or account(s). Demonstrates solid understanding of the features and benefits in the area of evolving storage technical solutions as well as how HPE solutions are differentiated from the competition. Maintains an outside-in view, stays abreast of competitors, leverages HPE’s opportunities and mitigates challenges. Exercises deep expertise of end to end data solutions leveraging the HPE storage portfolio and ecosystem of partners. Effectively uses references to craft a story that makes complex technologies seem simple & understandable for our customers. Actively hunts for solution opportunities in acquisition and development accounts to pursue new business. Actively generates customer interest and links business & financial benefits with technology. Brings a services-led approach to build stickiness through consultative engagements and financial constructs. Laser focused on the channel to forge relationships, provide enablement of key technologies, and co-sell to end-users. Responsible for the close plan for storage-related opportunities.

 ***Responsibilities:***

* Responsible for sales of storage products and solutions for data protection.
* Uses advanced storage expertise to seek out new opportunities for customer value by expanding and enhancing existing opportunities.
* Develops the long term sales pipeline and sets direction for business development, to increase the company's market share in data protection solutions.
* Builds sales readiness and reduces client learning curve through effective knowledge transfer in storage.
* Provides unique mastery and cross-portfolio knowledge to support account leads with integration of solutions.
* Directs and coordinates supporting sales activities related to pipeline hygiene through account managers, Presales, channel partners and other relevant stakeholders.
* Effectively uses internal sales tools to maintain a healthy pipeline and the account plan in a timely fashion.
* Collaborates across the HPE teams to deliver a consistent approach to developing business, including account planning for end to end solutions.

* Actively generates customer interest and anticipates customer's buying trends. Links business and financial benefits with technology offerings. Illustrates the ROI & TCO advantages of HPE offerings for the customer's business.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Sweden
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Sales
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

  

  

Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

  

  

**The Senior Builder Experience**

* Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the highest engineering standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly.
* AI-Supported Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
* Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
* Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.
  

  

**What You'll Actually Be Building**

* Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
* Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
* Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
* Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
* Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
* Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
* Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
* Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
* Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.
  

  

**You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…**

* You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
* You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
* You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
* You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when "fast" is the wrong call.
* You've mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.
* You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
* You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.
  

  

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)
* Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks
* Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers
* Track record of influencing enterprise software product roadmaps through field engineering insight
* Open-source contributions, published technical writing, or conference presentations
  

  

  

  

Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.


Accommodations


If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .


Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.


Posting Statement


Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Customer Growth Executive
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

  

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

  

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

  

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.


Let’s build what’s next, together.

  

**Job Description:**

  

**Customer Orientation:**

  

* Build and maintain trusted relationship with assigned (Tier1) clients to achieve overall customer health and growth (regular meetings, share Infobip strategy and roadmap, position Infobip against competitors).
* Serve as a focal point for client when it comes to meeting client’s business and technical expectations (technical escalations, services/product adoption, communicate customer feedback and ideas to Product teams). Coordinate different teams in order to best serve customer.
* Understand client’s structure and processes around choosing/implementing new solutions.
* Meet and exceed quarterly KPIs, to ensure overall business growth for assigned clients (gross profit, margin% and cross-sells as the most important metrics).
* Work closely with Customer Success for existing and future SaaS business.
* In cooperation with CPaaS Registrations, ensure client's account is properly set-up / collaborate with Platform Operations teams to arrange setup which enables client's activities based on agreed business scope (account creation and set-up, route management, sender registration, allowed content filtration setup and maintenance).
* In cooperation with Revenue Assurance, monitor and take actions to minimize health risks (actively involve ensuring financial collections and netting).
* Analyze and forecast client's traffic, take immediate reactions to ensure ongoing business growth, minimize losses, and maximize GP/revenue.

  

**Internal initiatives:**

  

* Power user, help improve Infobip’s internal tools for account setup, traffic monitoring and troubleshooting (Qlik, SU) by providing constructive feedback and ideas.
* Coordinate internal teams to timely fulfill client's requirements (Customer Success, Sales Engineers, Customer Support, CPaas Registrations, Platform Operations, Customer Analyst, Procurement, Revenue Assurance).
* Update all activities regarding client engagements and opportunities in dedicated tools (SF).
* Influence Infobip’s ever-evolving end-to-end customer experience by grasping and continuously promoting client’s perspective to the internal stakeholders.

  

**Continuous Development:**

  

* Promote team spirit and nourish critical thinking.
* Help mentor and onboard other team members and newcomers.
* Have an excellent knowledge of Infobip products, platform, and relevant markets.
* Have an excellent knowledge of client`s business and ways they (can) use Infobip.
* Be up to date with industry trends and competition. Stay always on top with competition and latest industry trends.

  

**What Makes You a Strong Fit:**

  

* 2-3 years of proven experience in B2B sales, consistently meeting or exceeding quota.
* Fluent in **English**
* Strong knowledge of industry and technology trends relevant to Infobip: CPaaS, CCaaS, customer engagement and conversational AI — and channels such as (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, voice, email, Viber and other OTT channels) is an advantage.
* Strong commercial mindset with clear ownership of revenue, margin, and retention metrics
* Ability to navigate complex customer organizations and coordinate multiple internal stakeholders
* Strategic, data-driven, and comfortable forecasting and performance analysis
* Confident communicator and relationship builder at multiple seniority levels

  

**Why you'll love it here**  

  

**• Financial rewards & recognition** - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
  

**• Flexible work arrangements** - Our hybrid, office-first setup brings people together in the office, with work-from-home flexibility and flexible working hours.
  

**• Work-life balance and Well-being** - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
  

**• Career mobility** - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
  

**• Professional development** - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
  

**• International mobility** - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.
  

  

*While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.*

  

**Diversity drives connection**

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.


No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.


**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**

title: IRIS² Software Technical Lead
description:
**Description**
---------------


The IRIS² Software Technical Lead is responsible for the technical coordination, integration, and delivery of the complete software scope for the IRIS² EU Communication Gateway programme.
  

  

The role ensures that software products and services delivered by SSC Space and its subcontractors are aligned with programme requirements, approved architectures, system interfaces, cybersecurity requirements, configuration baselines, and integration milestones.
  

  

Working closely with the Software & Platform Architect, System Engineering, IVV, Cyber Security, PA/QA, Configuration Management, Operations, and supplier organizations, the Software Technical Lead coordinates software activities throughout the full lifecycle, from requirements allocation and supplier development through integration, verification, release, acceptance, and transition to operations.
  

  

As SSC Space is responsible for delivering the complete software solution while leveraging specialist subcontractors for product development, this role is critical in ensuring that all software components come together as a coherent, compliant, secure, and supportable operational system.  

  

  

**Requirements**
----------------


**Required Qualifications & Experience**
* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience leading complex software or software-intensive system deliveries.
* Strong understanding of the complete software lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, development, integration, verification, release, and maintenance.
* Experience coordinating software delivered by multiple subcontractors, vendors, or external development teams.
* Experience working within a prime contractor, systems integrator, or comparable multi-supplier environment.
* Strong understanding of software requirements management, interface management, release management, configuration management, and verification processes.
* Experience integrating commercial off-the-shelf (COTS), customized, and supplier-developed software into larger solutions.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software factories, automated testing, artifact management, and controlled deployment processes.
* Knowledge of secure software development, vulnerability management, software supply-chain security, and DevSecOps principles.
* Experience managing technical risks, supplier dependencies, competing priorities, and software delivery challenges.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder-management, and coordination skills.
* Ability to challenge supplier solutions constructively while maintaining collaborative working relationships.

**Desirable Experience**
* Space ground segment, satellite communications, telecommunications, defence, or mission-critical infrastructure environments.
* Distributed monitoring, control, orchestration, or network-management systems.
* Complex system integrations involving RF systems, modems, operational technology, infrastructure, and external control systems.
* ECSS, ESA, or other regulated engineering and software development environments.
* Subsystem, Ground Segment, and end-to-end IVV/IVVQ programmes.
* Security-sensitive or accreditation-driven systems.
* Containerized, cloud-native, or virtualized deployment environments.
* High-availability and geographically distributed operational systems.
* Long-lifecycle systems requiring controlled maintenance, upgrades, patching, and technology evolution.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Software Technical Coordination**
* Lead and coordinate the complete EU COMM GW software scope across SSC Space and subcontractor organizations.
* Establish and maintain the overall software engineering, integration, and delivery strategy.
* Coordinate software planning, releases, and deliverables in alignment with programme milestones.
* Ensure alignment between software requirements, architecture, supplier work packages, interfaces, and verification activities.
* Maintain visibility of software progress, risks, dependencies, technical issues, and delivery readiness.
* Coordinate resolution of cross-supplier software issues and conflicting technical assumptions.
* Provide consolidated software status reporting and technical input to programme reviews and governance forums.
* Escalate significant software risks, supplier issues, or unresolved dependencies through the appropriate programme governance channels.

**Requirements & Compliance Management**
* Coordinate allocation of software requirements across products, components, and suppliers.
* Ensure software requirements are fully traceable through implementation and verification activities.
* Clarify requirements and resolve gaps, overlaps, ambiguities, or conflicting allocations.
* Ensure applicable engineering, cybersecurity, PA/QA, RAMS, configuration-management, and documentation requirements are effectively flowed down to suppliers.
* Monitor software compliance and coordinate closure of identified gaps and findings.
* Support maintenance of software requirements, traceability, and verification status.

**Supplier Software Coordination**
* Act as the primary technical coordination point for software subcontractors.
* Ensure supplier software plans, releases, and deliveries support programme schedules and integration objectives.
* Coordinate technical reviews of software designs, interfaces, releases, and verification evidence.
* Ensure suppliers provide controlled software artifacts, release notes, test evidence, configuration information, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate supplier participation in subsystem, Ground Segment, and end-to-end integration activities.
* Monitor software defects, non-conformances, changes, and corrective actions.
* Support supplier-performance assessments together with programme and subcontractor-management teams.
* Ensure sufficient transfer of technical knowledge to support integration, operations, and lifecycle maintenance.

**Software Integration & Interface Management**
* Coordinate integration of supplier software products into the complete EU COMM GW solution.
* Ensure software interfaces are adequately defined, controlled, documented, and verified.
* Coordinate implementation and verification of interfaces between gateway management, antenna management, modem and network-management functions, RF monitoring systems, infrastructure platforms, and external Ground Segment systems.
* Maintain visibility of interface dependencies and integration constraints across suppliers.
* Coordinate compatibility and interoperability testing activities.
* Ensure simulators, emulators, stubs, and representative test environments are available when required.
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of software integration issues.

title: Cloud Onboarding & Delivery Lead - Playground CloudOps
description:
Technical projects rarely go exactly to plan. Requirements shift, priorities change, and the customer, the engineers, and sales all see the same project from different angles. We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing all of that together and steering it to a great result.


At Playground Tech, we help our customers build, migrate, and run their cloud platforms on AWS and Azure, from new clusters and landing zones to full-scale migrations and our managed CloudOps service.


Within Playground Tech, our dedicated CloudOps team delivers our managed cloud operations as a core product and service. As our **Cloud Onboarding & Delivery Lead**, you'll step in at the tail end of pre-sales to validate the technical scope and make sure these projects land: on time, with the right scope, and with everyone pulling in the same direction.

### **What you'll actually do**


You'll own our technical onboarding and migration projects from pre-sales validation through kickoff to final handover into our CloudOps team, acting as the customer's main point of contact throughout. You won't configure the clusters yourself, but you'll understand the architecture well enough to review an inventory of virtual machines, ask the right questions, and spot risks before they become problems.


In practice, you'll:

* **Drive technical projects end to end:** Plan, run, and follow up on cloud projects, including platform builds, migrations, and CloudOps onboardings, often managing several in parallel.
* **Be the customer's go-to person:** Lead the dialogue with technical stakeholders (from CTOs and Engineering Managers to Architects and Developers), run status meetings, and keep expectations, scope, and timelines aligned.
* **Connect engineering, customers, external partners, and sales:** Bridge the gap between the customer, external cloud partners, and our internal CloudOps team of cloud engineers. Translate customer needs into actionable engineering work, and turn technical details into clear decisions.
* **Create structure where there is none:** Set up plans, priorities, and ways of working that hold up when the project gets complex.
* **Adapt when things change:** Re-plan, re-prioritise, and communicate clearly when scope, priorities, or circumstances shift.
* **Help us get better:** Continuously improve how we deliver projects and onboard customers into our CloudOps service, sharing what you learn with the team.


There's always something to plan, untangle, or move forward, at a pace that keeps things interesting!

### **Who are you?**


You have experience leading technical projects, ideally as a Technical Project Manager, Customer Success Manager or Onboarding Consultant. You come from a hands-on technical background in cloud, infrastructure, or IT services, and are comfortable owning the customer relationship.


You don't need to be an active engineer today, but you have the technical foundation to earn trust with senior infrastructure profiles and speak their language.


You would probably describe yourself as someone who:

* **Creates structure in complex environments:** When there are many moving parts and unclear requirements, you're the one who brings order and a clear way forward.
* **Plans and follows through:** You break work down, set realistic plans, and follow up until things are actually done.
* **Adapts quickly:** You listen to input, pick up on changes, and re-plan without losing momentum.
* **Communicates clearly:** You keep people informed before they have to ask, adapt your message to the audience, and aren't afraid to raise difficult topics early.
* **Bridges engineers, customers, and sales:** You're equally at home in a technical deep-dive, a customer meeting, and a conversation with sales, and you keep all three connected.
* **Speaks engineer:** You understand cloud computing, architecture, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure as code well enough to have real conversations with our engineers, and you don't flinch at a spreadsheet full of VMs.
* **Thrives at a fast pace:** You enjoy a scale-up environment where things move quickly and you get to shape how the work is done.
* **Goes where the problems are:** You have low ego and step into the unknown. When something feels too difficult, you say "give me some time to learn", and you never do it alone: we do this together.

### **Language Requirement**


Fluency in Swedish is a **very-nice-to-have**, and English is an **absolute must**.

*Why? Because many of our collaborations and client environments in Stockholm operate in Swedish, while our technical dialogue and documentation often happen in English.*

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is straightforward:

* Upload your CV or link your LinkedIn profile.
* Answer a couple of quick questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise).
* Feel free to drop a link to your GitHub, architecture write-ups, or anything technical you're proud of.

**Please Note:**


Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already hold a permanent and independent right to work in Sweden *and* reside in the greater Stockholm area.

 **Buzzword bingo:** AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, CloudOps, cloud architecture, migrations, onboarding, technical project management, stakeholder management, CSM, AWS, Amazon, Microsoft, Azure, Google GCP, Projektledare, Moln

Ability to understand business needs and turn complex requirements into clear priorities and actionable next steps.
  

Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in working with both technical and business stakeholders.

  

Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving business readiness.

 **Meritorious**

Knowledge of engineering environments, datacenter, cloud, DevSecOps, CI/CD, data, or AI.  

Understanding of Ericsson R&D product development flows

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Varje kreditbeslut på DBT vilar på data om svenska medelstora företag, från bokföring och kreditupplysningar till årsredovisningar och ägarstrukturer. Datan och begreppen finns redan på plats. Som Applied AI Engineer gör du dem till pålitliga AI-drivna arbetsflöden som våra kreditanalytiker, portföljförvaltare och AML-team använder varje dag.

**Om DBT**  

DBT finansierar etablerade svenska medelstora företag. Vi fokuserar på en tydlig kundgrupp och ett tydligt behov, och sedan januari 2026 är vi en del av NOBA-gruppen.

**Plattformen**  

Dataplattformen bygger på Dagster, Data Build Tool och DuckLake ovanpå S3, med hundratals modeller uppdelade per domän som kredit, portfölj och AML. Backend är byggd i TypeScript med Hono och PostgreSQL. Allt körs i AWS, i samma monorepo, med typsäkerhet genom hela flödet.

**Om rollen**

* Du äger AI-drivna arbetsflöden hela vägen till användning i produktion, byggda på data och begrepp som redan finns.
* Du börjar med ett arbetsflöde som verksamheten äger och skeppar det hela vägen innan du breddar.
* Du bygger utvärdering och granskning in i varje flöde: spårbara underlag för varje svar, hantering av undantag och en tydlig väg till mänsklig granskning.
* Du använder retrieval och verktygsorkestrering där det gör nytta.
* Du övervakar kvaliteten i produktion och säger till när ett flöde inte används eller när kvaliteten sjunker.
* Du kommer överens med verksamheten om hur nyttan mäts, i sparad tid, kvalitet och faktisk användning, och följer upp det.
* Du arbetar nära kreditanalytiker, vår Product Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Senior Data Engineer och Senior Software Engineer.
* Du skyddar datan. Vi hanterar kredit-, bokförings- och personuppgifter och behandlar dataskydd som en del av jobbet.
* Du arbetar agent-first. AI-agenter skriver all kod. Du bygger arbetsflödena och orkestreringen av agenterna.

**Exempel på vad du kan åstadkomma**

* Kredit lägger hälften så mycket tid på dokumentintag. Agenter gör första genomgången och kredit granskar.
* En agent tar fram första utkastet till ett kreditPM. Kreditanalytikern redigerar bara.

**Vi tror att du har:**

* Erfarenhet av att bygga LLM-baserade lösningar som används i produktion.
* Goda kunskaper i Python eller TypeScript, och i SQL.
* Erfarenhet av utvärdering av LLM-flöden, till exempel testset, evals och kvalitetsmått.
* Erfarenhet av retrieval, tool use eller agentramverk.
* Vana att mäta nytta i verksamheten, inte bara modellprestanda.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av dokumenttolkning, till exempel årsredovisningar, bokföring eller avtal.
* Övervakning och spårbarhet för AI i produktion.
* Data Build Tool, Dagster eller AWS.
* Tidigare erfarenhet från fintech eller andra reglerade miljöer.

**Det här är du bra på:**

* Att lägga stor vikt vid korrekthet och spårbarhet, eftersom ett felaktigt svar kan få stora konsekvenser.
* Att ta ansvar för helheten och följa ett flöde hela vägen till den som använder det.
* Att sätta dig in i affären, från kreditprocessen till bokföringen.
* Att döma framgång efter nytta i produktion, inte efter antal prototyper.
* Att dokumentera och dela kunskap på eget initiativ.
* Att fatta beslut och stå för dem i ett litet team.

title: Driver du eget och vill jobba inom försvarsindustrin? Få uppdrag du inte når på egen hand!
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

 **Jobbeskrivning**  

Du driver eget och väljer själv dina uppdrag. Men många av de mest spännande projekten inom svensk försvarsindustri kräver säkerhetsskyddsavtal och säkerhetsprövning, och dessa kan man sällan teckna som enskild konsult.


Därför erbjuder AFRY nu **projektanställning för erfarna egenkonsulter** i uppdrag hos ledande aktörer inom försvar och säkerhet. Du får tillgång till uppdragen. Vi tar hand om avtal, säkerhetsprocess och administration.

**Så funkar det**

* Uppdragen är minst 6 månader och längden varierar beroende på projekt
* Arbetet sker till största delen på plats hos kund
* Du är anställd hos AFRY under uppdraget, med lön, pension, försäkringar och semester
* Du behöver inte avveckla ditt bolag. Det kan ligga kvar under anställningen
* Vill du stanna efter uppdraget finns den möjligheten

  

**Kvalifikationer** **Vi söker dig som är**

* Embedded Software Engineer
* Systemingenjör
* Integratör / V&V
* Elektronikkonstruktör
* Projektledare
* ...eller har en närliggande profil. Hör av dig ändå!

**Vi tror att du**

* Har flera års erfarenhet inom ditt område, gärna som konsult
* Snabbt kommer in i en ny kundmiljö och levererar
* Är svensk medborgare och kan genomgå säkerhetsprövning

  

**Ytterligare information** **Sista ansökningsdag är 17 januari 2027**. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


Nyfiken men vill veta mer om villkoren? Hör av dig till oss för ett förutsättningslöst samtal. Vi går igenom aktuella uppdrag, ersättning och hur det praktiskt funkar med ditt bolag.


Klara Willard  

Talent Acquisition Partner  

klara.willard@afry.com


För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning.


Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Senior Software Verification Engineer
description:
Bidra till säker och tillförlitlig avionikmjukvara genom kvalificerad verifiering, testautomation och HIL-testning i ett avancerat utvecklingsprojekt. Vill du bidra till utvecklingen av säkerhetskritisk mjukvara i ett avancerat flygtekniskt projekt? I rollen som Senior Software Verification Engineer arbetar du med verifiering och testning som säkerställer hög kvalitet, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet. Om rollen Arbeta med verifiering av mjukvara för avancerade tekniska system.
  
  

Säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller definierade krav, kvalitetsnivåer och relevanta standarder. Vara en viktig del av ett erfaret team inom säkerhetskritisk produktutveckling. Det här kommer du göra Utforma och underhålla testplaner, testfall och automatiserade testskript. Genomföra tester, analysera resultat och dokumentera verifieringsunderlag.
  
  

Arbeta med HIL-riggar för att simulera verkliga driftsförhållanden. , felsöka och följa upp mjukvarudefekter tillsammans med utvecklingsteam. Föreslå förbättringar som stärker mjukvarans kvalitet och testbarhet. Vi söker dig som har Flerårig erfarenhet av mjukvarutest eller verifiering inom avionik, fordonsindustri eller inbyggda system.
  
  

Erfarenhet av testautomation och skriptning. God förståelse för testmetodik, testverktyg och strukturerad testdokumentation. Kunskap om säkerhetskritisk mjukvaruutveckling och relevanta utvecklingsprocesser. Meriterande erfarenhet av testning på både hög och låg nivå samt agila arbetssätt.
  
  

Teknik & Verktyg Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) dSPACE eller liknande HIL-plattformar Testautomation Skriptning DO-178C eller liknande standarder för avionikmjukvara Praktisk information Ort: Huskvarna Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat Språk: Svenska och engelska
